Preprocess Illumina 10X Genomics GEX / CITE-seq / HTO data by sample - from Cell Ranger raw matrix

+ CITE-seq: cell-surface protein measurements
+ Cell Hashing: tagged antibodies against ubiquitous cell surface proteins to multiplex samples

Code adapted from:

+ https://satijalab.org/seurat/articles/hashing_vignette
+ https://satijalab.org/seurat/articles/multimodal_vignette
+ Meijie/Shaoli code (CCRGB-42)
+ https://github.com/niaid/dsb

```{r setup, message=FALSE}
#knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir =  "/data/khanlab3/gb_omics/projects/khan/ccrgb_6/analysis/")
#knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, dev="png",fig.path="masih/",fig.height=5,fig.width=7)

library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(dsb)
```

# Create Seurat object

## Read h5 file location from command line

```{r}
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)

if (length(args) > 0) {
  sample <- args[1]
  location <- args[2]

  h5_file <- paste(location,sample,sep="/")
} else {
  sample <- "GPC2_CD276_BisCAR_CTRL"
  h5_file <- "/data/khanlab3/gb_omics/projects/khan/ccrgb_95/analysis/BiCisCar/cellranger/GPC2_CD276_BisCAR_CTRL/outs/multi/count/raw_feature_bc_matrix.h5"

  #sample <- "SCAF3357_tEGFR_Pooled"
  #h5_file <- "/data/khanlab3/gb_omics/projects/khan/ccrgb_42/raw/SCAF3357_tEGFR_Pooled_raw_feature_bc_matrix.h5" # fallback for interactive use
}
print(paste("Using input file:", h5_file))
```

## Load h5 data

Assumes data includes only shared barcodes

```{r}
sample.data <- Read10X_h5(h5_file)

# Simplify feature names
rownames(sample.data[["Antibody Capture"]]) <- gsub(pattern = "_*TotalSeqC", replacement = "",rownames(sample.data[["Antibody Capture"]]))

# Simplify barcode names (remove -1)
colnames(sample.data[["Gene Expression"]]) <- gsub(pattern = "-1", replacement = "",colnames(sample.data[["Gene Expression"]]))
colnames(sample.data[["Antibody Capture"]]) <- gsub(pattern = "-1", replacement = "",colnames(sample.data[["Antibody Capture"]]))
```

## Create Seurat object 

Initialize with RNA, add ADT and HTO assays 

```{r}
seurat_obj <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = sample.data[["Gene Expression"]],project=sample)
seurat_obj[["ADT"]] <- CreateAssayObject(counts = sample.data[["Antibody Capture"]][5:22,])
seurat_obj[["HTO"]] <- CreateAssayObject(counts = sample.data[["Antibody Capture"]][1:4,])
```

To make object more manageable, remove cells with few RNA reads (will likely be removed during HTO demultiplexing anyway). This also fixes the error during HTODemux.

```{r}
seurat_obj <- subset(seurat_obj,nCount_RNA > 100)
```

# Normalize data 

Log normalization for RNA, CLR transformation for antibodies

+ HTO: margin=1 for normalization across feature
+ CITE-seq: margin=2 for normalization within the cell, accounts for differences in ADT depth across cells (https://github.com/satijalab/seurat/issues/8159)
* Overwritten by DSB normalization after HTO demultiplexing

Should be updated to provide list of antibodies/hashing tags

```{r}
seurat_obj <- NormalizeData(seurat_obj)
seurat_obj <- NormalizeData(seurat_obj, assay = "ADT", normalization.method = "CLR", margin = 2)
seurat_obj <- NormalizeData(seurat_obj, assay = "HTO", normalization.method = "CLR")
```

# Demultiplex samples by HTO

Performs clustering on normalized values to separate cells into K(number of samples)+1 clusters. For each HTO, classify each cell as positive or negative/ambiguous, with cross-sample doublets positive for more than one.

```{r, eval=FALSE}
seurat_obj <- HTODemux(seurat_obj, assay = "HTO", positive.quantile = 0.9999)
```

Alternatively, MULTIseqDemux (workaround for error due to 0 counts - based on Seurat issues, common). Uses default parameters.

```{r}
seurat_obj <- MULTIseqDemux(seurat_obj, assay = "HTO")
```

## Visualize demultiplexing results

```{r}
# Classification summary
table(seurat_obj$MULTI_ID)

# Number of UMIs by classification
Idents(seurat_obj) <- "MULTI_ID"
VlnPlot(seurat_obj, features = "nCount_RNA", log = TRUE)

# Ridge plot for HTO signals
RidgePlot(seurat_obj, assay = "HTO", features = rownames(seurat_obj[["HTO"]]),ncol=2)

# Visualize pairs to confirm mutual exclusivity
FeatureScatter(seurat_obj, feature1 = "HashTag2", feature2 = "HashTag3")
FeatureScatter(seurat_obj, feature1 = "HashTag2", feature2 = "HashTag4")
FeatureScatter(seurat_obj, feature1 = "HashTag3", feature2 = "HashTag4")

# Remove negative cells from the object
seurat_obj.subset <- subset(seurat_obj, idents = "Negative", invert = TRUE)

# Plot PCA on HTO data
DefaultAssay(seurat_obj.subset) <- "HTO"
seurat_obj.subset <- ScaleData(seurat_obj.subset, features = rownames(seurat_obj.subset),verbose = FALSE)
seurat_obj.subset <- RunPCA(seurat_obj.subset, features = rownames(seurat_obj.subset), approx = FALSE)
DimPlot(seurat_obj.subset)
```

## Extract singlets and negatives

```{r}
seurat_obj.singlet <- subset(seurat_obj.subset, idents = "Doublet", invert = TRUE)
seurat_obj.negative <- subset(seurat_obj, idents = "Negative")
rm(seurat_obj.subset)
```

# ADT normalization with DSB

Removes ambient noise using empty droplets and uses non-specific isotype controls to remove inter-cell technical variation

```{r}
isotypes = c("mIgG1","mIgG2a","mIgG2b","ahIgG")

seurat_obj.singlet[["ADT"]]$data = DSBNormalizeProtein(cell_protein_matrix = seurat_obj.singlet[["ADT"]]$counts, 
                                     empty_drop_matrix = seurat_obj.negative[["ADT"]]$counts, 
                                     use.isotype.control = TRUE, isotype.control.name.vec = isotypes)
```

# GEX QC and filtering

Adjust hardcoded filters

```{r}
seurat_obj.singlet[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(seurat_obj.singlet, assay = "RNA", pattern = "^MT-")

VlnPlot(seurat_obj.singlet, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"))
hist(seurat_obj.singlet$nFeature_RNA)
hist(seurat_obj.singlet$percent.mt)

seurat_obj.singlet.filtered <- subset(seurat_obj.singlet, subset = nFeature_RNA > 400 & nFeature_RNA < 8000 & percent.mt < 20)
table(seurat_obj.singlet.filtered$MULTI_ID)
VlnPlot(seurat_obj.singlet.filtered, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"), ncol = 3)
```

# Save object

```{r}
saveRDS(seurat_obj.singlet, file = "sample.singlet.rds")
saveRDS(seurat_obj.singlet.filtered, file = "sample.singlet.filtered.rds")
```
